“这是军事秘密，我无可奉告！”
“刀呢！”宋大根恶狠狠地说道。
“根据日内瓦公约，你们不得虐待战俘，我是战俘，你们杀我就是违反了日内瓦公约。”
眼看时间一点点过去，马连长也急了，上去就是一拳：“说不说！”
“我是战俘！”对方强硬地说道。
刘济民走到他身旁蹲下，用刺刀挑起他的下巴，淡淡地说道：“战俘是吧？我是医生，我会治你这个病。
来人，把他的军装扒了！脱了这身狗皮，你可就不是兵了，是间谍！全世界对待间谍的方式，你懂吗？
忘了，我是医生。”刘济民用刺刀挑开他的衬衣，刀尖的冰凉轻轻刺破胸前的皮肤，往下划了划：“你知道这里是哪里吗？心脏，但是刺下去不会让你死，我给你开个口，你低头能看到它在跳动，顺便还能说一句‘早安，越南’。”
月光下，对方看着刘济民的脸如同恶魔一般，觉得真会杀了他，于是泄气摊倒在地，开始配合了起来。
“报告你的姓名职务。”
“阮林，独立123团8连，一排长。”
“山上是一个连？有没有增援？”
“1号高地是核心高地，我们是加强连，配备有两挺重机枪.....”对方将家底全都讲了出来。
“这些内容，全部报告给营指！”连长马贵生高兴地说道，另外派人把俘虏送回了营指。
五点四十，全连行进到一号高地下侧。天马上就要亮了，必须在夜色的掩护下建立好进攻阵地。
“机枪阵地放在两翼，压制敌碉堡和重火力点，并封锁敌人交通壕。一排三三制阵型主攻，跟上一个火箭筒班，敲掉敌人碉堡和火力点。二排攻击旁边无名高地，牵制敌人。
三排预备队，随时支援。迫击炮对准既定目标，随时准备轰炸，部队冲锋到阵地二十米处，迫击炮炮口抬高，轰炸敌人内部交通壕和山坡后侧，打击有生力量。”
攻击方案确定并汇报给营指后得到同意，刘济民和连长分别去看了炮兵阵地和重机枪阵地。

"This is a military secret, I have no comment!"
"Where's the knife!" Song Dagen said viciously.
"According to the Geneva Conventions, you are not allowed to mistreat prisoners of war. I am a prisoner of war. If you kill me, you are violating the Geneva Conventions."
Seeing the time passing by, Captain Ma became anxious and punched him: "Say it or not!"
"I am a prisoner of war!" the other party said forcefully.
Liu Jimin walked to him and squatted down, raised his chin with a bayonet, and said calmly: "Prisoner of war, right? I am a doctor, and I will treat your disease.
Someone, take off his uniform! If you take off this skin, you are no longer a soldier, but a spy! Do you understand the way the world treats spies?
Forget, I am a doctor. Liu Jimin opened his shirt with a bayonet. The cold tip of the knife gently pierced the skin on his chest and scratched downward: "Do you know where this is?" Heart, but stabbing it will not kill you. I will open an opening for you. You can see it beating when you look down. By the way, you can also say "Good morning, Vietnam." "
Under the moonlight, the other party looked at Liu Jimin's face like a demon, and felt that he would really kill him, so he collapsed to the ground in frustration and began to cooperate.
"Report your name and position."
"Ruan Lin, 8th Company of the 123rd Independent Regiment, platoon leader."
"Is there a company on the mountain? Are there any reinforcements?"
"Highland No. 1 is the core highland. We are a reinforced company equipped with two heavy machine guns..." The other party told them all about their family background.
"Report all these contents to the battalion commander!" Company Commander Ma Guisheng said happily, and sent someone to send the prisoners back to the battalion commander.
At 5:40, the entire company marched to the lower side of Highland No. 1. It will be daybreak soon, and an offensive position must be established under the cover of darkness.
"Machine gun positions are placed on both wings to suppress enemy bunkers and heavy firepower points, and block enemy communication trenches. One row of three-three formations is the main attack, followed by a rocket launcher squad, knocking out enemy bunkers and firepower points. The second platoon attacks the unknown high ground next to it to contain the enemy.
Three platoons of reserves are ready for support. The mortar was aimed at the designated target and ready to bomb at any time. The troops charged to the position 20 meters away, raised the muzzle of the mortar, and bombed the enemy's internal communication trenches and the back of the hillside to attack the effective forces. "
After the attack plan was determined and reported to the battalion commander, Liu Jimin and the company commander visited the artillery position and the heavy machine gun position respectively.
